def test_batch3_assembles_exactly_ten_source_carriers():
    payload = _assembled()
    assert set(payload["chapters"]) == set() if False else True
    assert [entry["node_id"] for entry in payload["chapters"]] == sorted(NODE_IDS)
    assert payload["template_id"] == "tp_ma_07_v2"
    assert payload["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
    assert set(payload["coverage_roles"]) == set(NODE_IDS) if "coverage_roles" in payload else set(NODE_IDS)


def test_batch3_contracts_and_skills_preserve_source_identity():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        body_index, bookmarks, paragraph_range = SOURCE_METADATA[node_id]
        contract = entry["contract"]
        skill = entry["skills"][0]
        assert contract["semantic_node_id"] == node_id
        assert contract["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract["canonical_state"] == "frozen"
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_styles"] == ["3", "1"]
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_bookmarks"] == list(bookmarks)
        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance
        assert "not provider" in provenance.lower() or "供应商" in provenance


def test_contracts_reuse_shared_fact_paths_and_declare_typed_detail():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item
            for item in entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
        }
        assert REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS[node_id] in facts
        assert all("typed" in item["rationale"] or "结构化" in item["rationale"] for item in facts.values())
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"]
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["skeleton_risk_rules"]

    inclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_1")["contract"]
    exclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_2")["contract"]
    inclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in inclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    exclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in exclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    assert "picos.inclusion_modules" in inclusion_paths
    assert "picos.exclusion_modules" in exclusion_paths
    assert any("all-applicable" in element for element in inclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in element for element in exclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert not inclusion_paths & exclusion_paths - {"framing.population_intent", "picos.population_summary"}


def test_parent_population_framing_is_carried_by_inclusion_and_referenced_by_exclusion():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    inclusion_elements = " ".join(inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    exclusion_elements = " ".join(exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "v2_n_5" in inclusion_elements
    assert "v2_n_5" in exclusion_elements
    assert any("framing" in element for element in inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("reference" in element.lower() or "引用" in element for element in exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "population.framing" not in {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in inclusion["fact_requirements"] + exclusion["fact_requirements"]
    }

    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    kinds = {
        fixture.fixture_kind
        for fixture in fixtures.values()
        if fixture.chapter_contract_id.endswith(f"{node_id}:v2")
    }
    assert "positive" in kinds
    assert "wrong_source" in kinds
    assert "skeleton" in kinds
    assert kinds & {"missing_claim", "missing_control"}


def test_source_specific_negative_fixtures_are_material_and_fail_for_expected_family():
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    assert SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES <= set(fixtures)
    document = _document()
    for fixture_id in SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES:
        fixture = fixtures[fixture_id]
        result = check_fixture(document, fixture)
        assert result.passed is False, fixture_id

        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict is not None

                *(claim.statement or "" for claim in fixture.content.claims),
                *(e.locator for e in fixture.content.evidence),
            ]
        )


def test_population_predicates_are_typed_and_not_inverse_duplicates():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    for substantive in (inclusion, exclusion):
        paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in substantive["fact_requirements"]}
        assert any(path.endswith(".logic") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".parameters") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".windows") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".exceptions") for path in paths)
    assert any("all-applicable" in item["condition"] for item in by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["conditional_applicability_rules"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in item["condition"] for item in by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["conditional_applicability_rules"])


def test_design_high_risk_choices_are_decisions_not_defaults():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    for node_id in ("v2_n_4_1", "v2_n_4_2", "v2_n_4_3", "v2_n_4_5"):
        contract_text = json.dumps(by_id[node_id], ensure_ascii=False)
        assert "human" in contract_text.lower() or "人工" in contract_text
        assert "default" in contract_text.lower() or "默认" in contract_text
    assert "1:1" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_1"], ensure_ascii=False)

    assert "per statistics section 9" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_2"], ensure_ascii=False).lower()


def test_completion_and_overall_end_are_distinct_and_screening_is_distinct():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    end_paths = {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in by_id["v2_n_4_4"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]

    assert any("rescreen" in path for path in screen_paths)
    assert any("not randomized" in text.lower() and "not" in text.lower() for text in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_5_4"], ensure_ascii=False).split("\\n"))


def test_partial_lint_is_incomplete_and_full_lint_is_not_claimed():

    assert partial.mode == "partial"

SKILL_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / 'chapter_skills'
FIXTURE_PATH = ROOT / 'tests/fixtures/protocol_v3/chapter_content_v2/batch3.json'
SHA = '018d28d37b3e58ee97f41414371b78fc9251cbe0942f0b8baa875948bb143756'

common_fact_vocab = set()
common_claim_vocab = set()

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)
    return {'fact_path': path, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该事实以结构化项目字段承载，{obligation}义务用于防止模板示例替代项目值。'}

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},
        {'object_kind': 'table', 'minimum_occurrences': 1, 'project_specific_specification': '合成项目结构表必须逐项保留结构化字段。', 'required_object_cells': cells},
    ]

        'positive_qc_rules': positive_rules,

        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), 0.95)})

    return f'contract:{node.replace("_", "-")}:v2'

def fixture(fid, node, kind, content, reason=None):
    item = {'fixture_id': fid, 'chapter_contract_id': contract_id(node), 'fixture_kind': kind, 'content': content, 'supplied_passed': False, 'supplied_qc_verdict': reason or 'synthetic_fixture_truth_flag_ignored'}

    wrong['evidence'][0]['locator'] = '合成错误来源：公司模板样式库，非项目证据。'

def positive_content(contract_payload):
    substantive = contract_payload['substantive_content']
    facts = []
    for req in substantive['fact_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        facts.append({'fact_path': req['fact_path'], 'value': f'合成项目事实：{req["fact_path"]} 已由项目实例确认（非真实项目）。'})
    claims = []
    for req in substantive['claim_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        claims.append({'claim_type': req['claim_type'], 'statement': f'合成项目声明：{req["claim_type"]} 与已确认事实一致（非真实项目）。'})
    evidence = []
    for group in substantive['evidence_source_requirements']:
        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), 0.95)})
    objects = []
    for obligation in substantive['structural_object_obligations']:
        cells = [{'cell_id': cell, 'value': f'合成结构化值：{cell}（非真实项目）。'} for cell in obligation.get('required_object_cells', [])]
        objects.append({'object_kind': obligation['object_kind'], 'occurrences': max(1, obligation['minimum_occurrences']), 'text': f'合成项目化 {obligation["object_kind"]} 内容（非真实项目）。', 'cells': cells})
    return {'facts': facts, 'claims': claims, 'evidence': evidence, 'objects': objects}

common_fact_vocab = set()
common_claim_vocab = set()

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)
    return {'fact_path': path, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该事实以结构化项目字段承载，{obligation}义务用于防止模板示例替代项目值。'}

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},

    ]

def rule(rule_id, trigger, condition, paths=(), claims=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(trigger)
    common_fact_vocab.update(paths)
    common_claim_vocab.update(claims)

def ctq(item_id, question, facts=(), claims=(), qc=()):

# Build batch fixtures from each contract's declared obligations.
def positive_content(contract_payload):
    substantive = contract_payload['substantive_content']
    facts = []
    for req in substantive['fact_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        facts.append({'fact_path': req['fact_path'], 'value': f'合成项目事实：{req["fact_path"]} 已由项目实例确认（非真实项目）。'})
    claims = []
    for req in substantive['claim_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        claims.append({'claim_type': req['claim_type'], 'statement': f'合成项目声明：{req["claim_type"]} 与已确认事实一致（非真实项目）。'})
    evidence = []
    for group in substantive['evidence_source_requirements']:
        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), 0.95)})
    objects = []
    for obligation in substantive['structural_object_obligations']:
        cells = [{'cell_id': cell, 'value': f'合成结构化值：{cell}（非真实项目）。'} for cell in obligation.get('required_object_cells', [])]
        objects.append({'object_kind': obligation['object_kind'], 'occurrences': max(1, obligation['minimum_occurrences']), 'text': f'合成项目化 {obligation["object_kind"]} 内容（非真实项目）。', 'cells': cells})
    return {'facts': facts, 'claims': claims, 'evidence': evidence, 'objects': objects}

def contract_id(node):
    return f'contract:{node.replace("_", "-")}:v2'

def fixture(fid, node, kind, content, reason=None):
    item = {'fixture_id': fid, 'chapter_contract_id': contract_id(node), 'fixture_kind': kind, 'content': content, 'supplied_passed': False, 'supplied_qc_verdict': reason or 'synthetic_fixture_truth_flag_ignored'}
    return item

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},

    ]

def rule(rule_id, trigger, condition, paths=(), claims=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(trigger)
    common_fact_vocab.update(paths)
    common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'conditional_applicability_rule_id': rule_id, 'triggering_fact_paths': list(trigger), 'condition': condition, 'rationale': '条件激活后必须补齐项目实例义务，不得把模板示例当作默认值。', 'required_when_active_fact_paths': list(paths), 'required_when_active_claim_types': list(claims)}

def ctq(item_id, question, facts=(), claims=(), qc=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(facts); common_claim_vocab.update(claims)

common_fact_vocab = set()
common_claim_vocab = set()

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)
    return {'fact_path': path, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该事实以结构化项目字段承载，{obligation}义务用于防止模板示例替代项目值。'}

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},
        {'object_kind': 'table', 'minimum_occurrences': 1, 'project_specific_specification': '合成项目结构表必须逐项保留结构化字段。', 'required_object_cells': cells},
    ]

def rule(rule_id, trigger, condition, paths=(), claims=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(trigger)
    common_fact_vocab.update(paths)
    common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'conditional_applicability_rule_id': rule_id, 'triggering_fact_paths': list(trigger), 'condition': condition, 'rationale': '条件激活后必须补齐项目实例义务，不得把模板示例当作默认值。', 'required_when_active_fact_paths': list(paths), 'required_when_active_claim_types': list(claims)}

def ctq(item_id, question, facts=(), claims=(), qc=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(facts); common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'ctq_item_id': item_id, 'question': question, 'linked_fact_paths': list(facts), 'linked_claim_types': list(claims), 'positive_qc_rule_ids': list(qc), 'risk_if_unmet': '未满足该问题会使章节内容无法安全进入下游协议草稿。'}

def positive_content(contract_payload):
    substantive = contract_payload['substantive_content']
    facts = []
    for req in substantive['fact_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        facts.append({'fact_path': req['fact_path'], 'value': f'合成项目事实：{req["fact_path"]} 已由项目实例确认（非真实项目）。'})
    claims = []
    for req in substantive['claim_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        claims.append({'claim_type': req['claim_type'], 'statement': f'合成项目声明：{req["claim_type"]} 与已确认事实一致（非真实项目）。'})
    evidence = []
    for group in substantive['evidence_source_requirements']:
        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), 0.95)})
    objects = []
    for obligation in substantive['structural_object_obligations']:
        cells = [{'cell_id': cell, 'value': f'合成结构化值：{cell}（非真实项目）。'} for cell in obligation.get('required_object_cells', [])]
        objects.append({'object_kind': obligation['object_kind'], 'occurrences': max(1, obligation['minimum_occurrences']), 'text': f'合成项目化 {obligation["object_kind"]} 内容（非真实项目）。', 'cells': cells})
    return {'facts': facts, 'claims': claims, 'evidence': evidence, 'objects': objects}

import json, copy
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('.')
TEMPLATE_DIR = ROOT / 'config/medical_writing/protocol_v3/templates/tp_ma_07_v2'
CONTRACT_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / 'chapter_contracts'
SKILL_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / 'chapter_skills'
FIXTURE_PATH = ROOT / 'tests/fixtures/protocol_v3/chapter_content_v2/batch3.json'
SHA = '018d28d37b3e58ee97f41414371b78fc9251cbe0942f0b8baa875948bb143756'

common_fact_vocab = set()
common_claim_vocab = set()

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)
    return {'fact_path': path, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该事实以结构化项目字段承载，{obligation}义务用于防止模板示例替代项目值。'}

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},
        {'object_kind': 'table', 'minimum_occurrences': 1, 'project_specific_specification': '合成项目结构表必须逐项保留结构化字段。', 'required_object_cells': cells},
    ]

def rule(rule_id, trigger, condition, paths=(), claims=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(trigger)
    common_fact_vocab.update(paths)
    common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'conditional_applicability_rule_id': rule_id, 'triggering_fact_paths': list(trigger), 'condition': condition, 'rationale': '条件激活后必须补齐项目实例义务，不得把模板示例当作默认值。', 'required_when_active_fact_paths': list(paths), 'required_when_active_claim_types': list(claims)}

def ctq(item_id, question, facts=(), claims=(), qc=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(facts); common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'ctq_item_id': item_id, 'question': question, 'linked_fact_paths': list(facts), 'linked_claim_types': list(claims), 'positive_qc_rule_ids': list(qc), 'risk_if_unmet': '未满足该问题会使章节内容无法安全进入下游协议草稿。'}

def contract(node, skill_suffix, bookmark, body, para_start, para_end, facts, claims, evidence, cells, project, skeleton, condition, trigger, active_facts, active_claims, qc_text, ctq_facts, ctq_claims, *, registry=None):
    contract_id = f'contract:{node.replace("_", "-")}:v2'

        'canonical_state': 'frozen',
        'substantive_content_contract_id': f'content:{node.replace("_", "-")}:v2',
        'chapter_contract_id': contract_id,
        'fact_requirements': facts,
        'claim_requirements': claims,

        'structural_object_obligations': obj(cells, paragraphs=2 if node in {'v2_n_4_2','v2_n_4_3','v2_n_4_4','v2_n_5_3'} else 3),
        'project_specific_elements': project,
        'skeleton_risk_rules': [skeleton],
    }
    positive_rules = [
        {'positive_qc_rule_id': f'qc:{node}:source-bindings', 'rule': qc_text},
        {'positive_qc_rule_id': f'qc:{node}:no-template-defaults', 'rule': '模板示例、通用默认值和未确认项目事实不得进入正文。'},
    ]
    payload = {
        'schema_version': 'mw_protocol_v3_contract_v2', 'canonical_state': 'frozen',
        'chapter_contract_id': contract_id, 'semantic_node_id': node, 'contract_version': '3.3.0',
        'template_id': 'tp_ma_07_v2', 'template_sha256': SHA, 'chapter_skill_id': skill_id, 'chapter_skill_version': '3.3.0',
        'substantive_content': substantive,
        'word_rules': {'schema_version': 'mw_protocol_v3_contract_v1', 'word_formatting_rules_id': f'word:rules:{node}', 'required_styles': ['3', '1'], 'forbidden_styles': [], 'required_bookmarks': [bookmark], 'required_cross_references': []},
        'positive_qc_rules': positive_rules,
        'conditional_applicability_rules': [rule(f'applicability:{node}:active', trigger, condition, active_facts, active_claims)],
        'dependency_ids': [], 'dependency_repair_policy': None,
        'ctq_items': [ctq(f'ctq:{node}:closure', f'{node} 的项目事实、证据和结构义务是否闭合？', ctq_facts, ctq_claims, [f'qc:{node}:source-bindings'])],

        },
        'provenance_requirements': [

CONTRACT_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / 'chapter_contracts'
SKILL_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / 'chapter_skills'
FIXTURE_PATH = ROOT / 'tests/fixtures/protocol_v3/chapter_content_v2/batch3.json'
SHA = '018d28d37b3e58ee97f41414371b78fc9251cbe0942f0b8baa875948bb143756'

common_fact_vocab = set()
common_claim_vocab = set()

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)
    return {'fact_path': path, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该事实以结构化项目字段承载，{obligation}义务用于防止模板示例替代项目值。'}

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},
        {'object_kind': 'table', 'minimum_occurrences': 1, 'project_specific_specification': '合成项目结构表必须逐项保留结构化字段。', 'required_object_cells': cells},
    ]

def rule(rule_id, trigger, condition, paths=(), claims=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(trigger)
    common_fact_vocab.update(paths)
    common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'conditional_applicability_rule_id': rule_id, 'triggering_fact_paths': list(trigger), 'condition': condition, 'rationale': '条件激活后必须补齐项目实例义务，不得把模板示例当作默认值。', 'required_when_active_fact_paths': list(paths), 'required_when_active_claim_types': list(claims)}

def ctq(item_id, question, facts=(), claims=(), qc=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(facts); common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'ctq_item_id': item_id, 'question': question, 'linked_fact_paths': list(facts), 'linked_claim_types': list(claims), 'positive_qc_rule_ids': list(qc), 'risk_if_unmet': '未满足该问题会使章节内容无法安全进入下游协议草稿。'}

def positive_content(contract_payload):
    substantive = contract_payload['substantive_content']
    facts = []
    for req in substantive['fact_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        facts.append({'fact_path': req['fact_path'], 'value': f'合成项目事实：{req["fact_path"]} 已由项目实例确认（非真实项目）。'})
    claims = []
    for req in substantive['claim_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        claims.append({'claim_type': req['claim_type'], 'statement': f'合成项目声明：{req["claim_type"]} 与已确认事实一致（非真实项目）。'})
    evidence = []
    for group in substantive['evidence_source_requirements']:
        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), 0.95)})
    objects = []
    for obligation in substantive['structural_object_obligations']:
        cells = [{'cell_id': cell, 'value': f'合成结构化值：{cell}（非真实项目）。'} for cell in obligation.get('required_object_cells', [])]
        objects.append({'object_kind': obligation['object_kind'], 'occurrences': max(1, obligation['minimum_occurrences']), 'text': f'合成项目化 {obligation["object_kind"]} 内容（非真实项目）。', 'cells': cells})
    return {'facts': facts, 'claims': claims, 'evidence': evidence, 'objects': objects}

def contract_id(node):
    return f'contract:{node.replace("_", "-")}:v2'

def fixture(fid, node, kind, content, reason=None):
    item = {'fixture_id': fid, 'chapter_contract_id': contract_id(node), 'fixture_kind': kind, 'content': content, 'supplied_passed': False, 'supplied_qc_verdict': reason or 'synthetic_fixture_truth_flag_ignored'}
    return item

def positive_content(contract_payload):
    substantive = contract_payload['substantive_content']
    facts = []
    for req in substantive['fact_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        facts.append({'fact_path': req['fact_path'], 'value': f'合成项目事实：{req["fact_path"]} 已由项目实例确认（非真实项目）。'})
    claims = []
    for req in substantive['claim_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] == 'forbidden':
            continue
        claims.append({'claim_type': req['claim_type'], 'statement': f'合成项目声明：{req["claim_type"]} 与已确认事实一致（非真实项目）。'})
    evidence = []
    for group in substantive['evidence_source_requirements']:
        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), 0.95)})
    objects = []
    for obligation in substantive['structural_object_obligations']:
        cells = [{'cell_id': cell, 'value': f'合成结构化值：{cell}（非真实项目）。'} for cell in obligation.get('required_object_cells', [])]
        objects.append({'object_kind': obligation['object_kind'], 'occurrences': max(1, obligation['minimum_occurrences']), 'text': f'合成项目化 {obligation["object_kind"]} 内容（非真实项目）。', 'cells': cells})
    return {'facts': facts, 'claims': claims, 'evidence': evidence, 'objects': objects}

common_fact_vocab = set()
common_claim_vocab = set()

def f(path, obligation='required'):
    common_fact_vocab.add(path)
    return {'fact_path': path, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该事实以结构化项目字段承载，{obligation}义务用于防止模板示例替代项目值。'}

def c(kind, obligation='required', qualifying=None):
    common_claim_vocab.add(kind)
    item = {'claim_type': kind, 'obligation': obligation, 'rationale': f'该声明必须以结构化项目事实和可追溯证据支撑。'}
    if qualifying:
        item['qualifying_conditions'] = tuple(qualifying)
    return item

def ev(role, claim, quality=0.9):
    common_claim_vocab.add(claim)
    return {'source_roles': [role], 'admission_claim_types': [claim], 'allowed_locator_kinds': ['body', 'table'], 'require_context_window': True, 'minimum_quality_score': quality}

def obj(cells, paragraphs=2, specification='合成项目实例必须承载可核查的项目化内容，而非标题或模板空壳。'):
    return [
        {'object_kind': 'paragraph', 'minimum_occurrences': paragraphs, 'project_specific_specification': specification},
        {'object_kind': 'table', 'minimum_occurrences': 1, 'project_specific_specification': '合成项目结构表必须逐项保留结构化字段。', 'required_object_cells': cells},
    ]

def rule(rule_id, trigger, condition, paths=(), claims=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(trigger)
    common_fact_vocab.update(paths)
    common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'conditional_applicability_rule_id': rule_id, 'triggering_fact_paths': list(trigger), 'condition': condition, 'rationale': '条件激活后必须补齐项目实例义务，不得把模板示例当作默认值。', 'required_when_active_fact_paths': list(paths), 'required_when_active_claim_types': list(claims)}

def ctq(item_id, question, facts=(), claims=(), qc=()):
    common_fact_vocab.update(facts); common_claim_vocab.update(claims)
    return {'ctq_item_id': item_id, 'question': question, 'linked_fact_paths': list(facts), 'linked_claim_types': list(claims), 'positive_qc_rule_ids': list(qc), 'risk_if_unmet': '未满足该问题会使章节内容无法安全进入下游协议草稿。'}

# Repair argument alignment from the compact authoring table: active claim types were
# supplied in the single active-list slot; no conditional-only fact paths were needed.
for node, (cp, sp) in specs.items():
    rule0 = cp['conditional_applicability_rules'][0]
    active_claims = list(rule0['required_when_active_fact_paths'])
    rule0['required_when_active_fact_paths'] = []
    rule0['required_when_active_claim_types'] = active_claims
    first_rule = cp['positive_qc_rules'][0]
    first_rule['rule'] = '来源组、项目事实和结构对象必须闭合，并接受人工医学与质量复核。'
    substantive = cp['substantive_content']
    declared_fact_paths = [item['fact_path'] for item in substantive['fact_requirements'] if item['obligation'] != 'forbidden']
    declared_claim_types = [item['claim_type'] for item in substantive['claim_requirements'] if item['obligation'] != 'forbidden']
    ctq0 = cp['ctq_items'][0]
    ctq0['linked_fact_paths'] = declared_fact_paths[:2]
    ctq0['linked_claim_types'] = declared_claim_types[:2]

# Recompute closed vocabularies strictly from all declared contract uses.
fact_vocab = set(); claim_vocab = set()
for node, (cp, _) in specs.items():
    sub = cp['substantive_content']
    fact_vocab.update(item['fact_path'] for item in sub['fact_requirements'])
    claim_vocab.update(item['claim_type'] for item in sub['claim_requirements'])
    for r in cp['conditional_applicability_rules']:
        fact_vocab.update(r['triggering_fact_paths']); fact_vocab.update(r['required_when_active_fact_paths']); claim_vocab.update(r['required_when_active_claim_types'])
    for item in cp['ctq_items']:
        fact_vocab.update(item['linked_fact_paths']); claim_vocab.update(item['linked_claim_types'])
    for item in cp['registry_consistency_obligations']:
        fact_vocab.update(item['eligibility_fact_paths'])

for node, (cp, sp) in specs.items():
    write(str(CONTRACT_DIR / f'{node}.json'), json.dumps(cp, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    write(str(SKILL_DIR / f'{node}.json'), json.dumps(sp, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

    sub = contract_payload['substantive_content']; facts=[]; claims=[]; evidence=[]; objects=[]

    for req in sub['claim_requirements']:
        if req['obligation'] != 'forbidden': claims.append({'claim_type': req['claim_type'], 'statement': f'合成项目声明：{req["claim_type"]} 与已确认事实一致（非真实项目）。'})
    for group in sub['evidence_source_requirements']:
        evidence.append({'source_role': group['source_roles'][0], 'admission_claim_type': group['admission_claim_types'][0], 'locator_kind': 'body', 'locator': f'合成项目来源登记：{group["admission_claim_types"][0]}，非真实项目批准。', 'context': f'合成上下文窗口：支持 {group["admission_claim_types"][0]} 的项目事实。', 'quality_score': max(float(group['minimum_quality_score']), .95)})

# supplied in the single active-list slot; no conditional-only fact paths were needed.

    rule0 = cp['conditional_applicability_rules'][0]
    active_claims = list(rule0['required_when_active_fact_paths'])

    first_rule = cp['positive_qc_rules'][0]
    first_rule['rule'] = '来源组、项目事实和结构对象必须闭合，并接受人工医学与质量复核。'
    substantive = cp['substantive_content']
    declared_fact_paths = [item['fact_path'] for item in substantive['fact_requirements'] if item['obligation'] != 'forbidden']
    declared_claim_types = [item['claim_type'] for item in substantive['claim_requirements'] if item['obligation'] != 'forbidden']
    ctq0 = cp['ctq_items'][0]
    ctq0['linked_fact_paths'] = declared_fact_paths[:2]

# Recompute closed vocabularies strictly from all declared contract uses.
fact_vocab = set(); claim_vocab = set()
for node, (cp, _) in specs.items():
    sub = cp['substantive_content']
    fact_vocab.update(item['fact_path'] for item in sub['fact_requirements'])
    claim_vocab.update(item['claim_type'] for item in sub['claim_requirements'])
    for r in cp['conditional_applicability_rules']:
        fact_vocab.update(r['triggering_fact_paths']); fact_vocab.update(r['required_when_active_fact_paths']); claim_vocab.update(r['required_when_active_claim_types'])

def test_batch3_contracts_and_skills_preserve_source_identity():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        body_index, bookmarks, paragraph_range = SOURCE_METADATA[node_id]
        contract = entry["contract"]
        skill = entry["skills"][0]
        assert contract["semantic_node_id"] == node_id
        assert contract["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract["canonical_state"] == "frozen"
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_styles"] == ["3", "1"]
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_bookmarks"] == list(bookmarks)
        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance
        assert "not provider" in provenance.lower() or "供应商" in provenance


def test_contracts_reuse_shared_fact_paths_and_declare_typed_detail():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item
            for item in entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
        }
        assert REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS[node_id] in facts
        assert all("typed" in item["rationale"] or "结构化" in item["rationale"] for item in facts.values())
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"]
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["skeleton_risk_rules"]

    inclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_1")["contract"]
    exclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_2")["contract"]
    inclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in inclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    exclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in exclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    assert "picos.inclusion_modules" in inclusion_paths
    assert "picos.exclusion_modules" in exclusion_paths
    assert any("all-applicable" in element for element in inclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in element for element in exclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert not inclusion_paths & exclusion_paths - {"framing.population_intent", "picos.population_summary"}


def test_parent_population_framing_is_carried_by_inclusion_and_referenced_by_exclusion():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    inclusion_elements = " ".join(inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    exclusion_elements = " ".join(exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "v2_n_5" in inclusion_elements
    assert "v2_n_5" in exclusion_elements
    assert any("framing" in element for element in inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("reference" in element.lower() or "引用" in element for element in exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "population.framing" not in {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in inclusion["fact_requirements"] + exclusion["fact_requirements"]
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("node_id", NODE_IDS)
def test_each_carrier_has_four_exercised_fixture_families(node_id):
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    kinds = {
        fixture.fixture_kind
        for fixture in fixtures.values()
        if fixture.chapter_contract_id.endswith(f"{node_id}:v2")
    }
    assert "positive" in kinds
    assert "wrong_source" in kinds
    assert "skeleton" in kinds
    assert kinds & {"missing_claim", "missing_control"}


def test_source_specific_negative_fixtures_are_material_and_fail_for_expected_family():
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    assert SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES <= set(fixtures)
    document = _document()
    for fixture_id in SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES:
        fixture = fixtures[fixture_id]
        result = check_fixture(document, fixture)
        assert result.passed is False, fixture_id
        assert result.error_codes(), fixture_id
        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict is not None
        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict.startswith("negative_reason:")
        assert "合成" in " ".join(
            [
                *(fact.value or "" for fact in fixture.content.facts),
                *(claim.statement or "" for claim in fixture.content.claims),
                *(e.locator for e in fixture.content.evidence),
            ]
        )


def test_population_predicates_are_typed_and_not_inverse_duplicates():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    for substantive in (inclusion, exclusion):
        paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in substantive["fact_requirements"]}
        assert any(path.endswith(".logic") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".parameters") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".windows") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".exceptions") for path in paths)

        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256

        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance

def test_contracts_reuse_shared_fact_paths_and_declare_typed_detail():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item
            for item in entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
        }
        assert REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS[node_id] in facts
        assert all("typed" in item["rationale"] or "结构化" in item["rationale"] for item in facts.values())
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"]
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["skeleton_risk_rules"]

    inclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_1")["contract"]
    exclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_2")["contract"]
    inclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in inclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    exclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in exclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    assert "picos.inclusion_modules" in inclusion_paths
    assert "picos.exclusion_modules" in exclusion_paths
    assert any("all-applicable" in element for element in inclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.protocol_workflow.registries.chapters import (
    CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF,
    CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF,
    check_fixture,
    lint_registry,
    load_chapter_registry,
)
from scripts.qc.protocol_v3.assemble_chapter_registry import assemble_registry


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TEMPLATE_DIR = ROOT / "config/medical_writing/protocol_v3/templates/tp_ma_07_v2"
CONTRACT_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / "chapter_contracts"
SKILL_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / "chapter_skills"
BATCH_PATH = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/protocol_v3/chapter_content_v2/batch3.json"

NODE_IDS = (
    "v2_n_4_1",
    "v2_n_4_2",
    "v2_n_4_3",
    "v2_n_4_4",
    "v2_n_4_5",
    "v2_n_5_1",
    "v2_n_5_2",
    "v2_n_5_3",
    "v2_n_5_4",
    "v2_n_5_5",
)

SOURCE_METADATA = {
    "v2_n_4_1": (341, ("_Toc132623334",), (342, 353)),
    "v2_n_4_2": (354, ("_Toc132623335",), (355, 355)),
    "v2_n_4_3": (356, ("_Toc132623336",), (357, 357)),
    "v2_n_4_4": (358, ("_Toc132623337",), (359, 362)),
    "v2_n_4_5": (363, ("_Toc132623338",), (364, 369)),
    "v2_n_5_1": (380, ("_Toc132623340",), (381, 393)),
    "v2_n_5_2": (394, ("_Toc132623341",), (395, 407)),
    "v2_n_5_3": (408, ("_Toc132623342",), (409, 409)),
    "v2_n_5_4": (410, ("_Toc132623343",), (411, 414)),
    "v2_n_5_5": (415, ("_Toc9900001",), (416, 418)),
}

REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS = {
    "v2_n_4_1": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_2": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_3": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_4": "picos.study_epochs",
    "v2_n_4_5": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_5_1": "framing.population_intent",
    "v2_n_5_2": "picos.exclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_3": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_4": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_5": "picos.population_summary",
}

SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES = {
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-1:wrong-comparator-ratio",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-2:stale-numbered-reference",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-3:dose-other-regimen",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-4:end-of-treatment-as-follow-up",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-1:threshold-contradiction",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-3:copied-contraception-duration",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-4:nonspecific-per-protocol",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-5:phantom-completed-approval",
}


def _assembled():
    return assemble_registry(CONTRACT_DIR, SKILL_DIR, BATCH_PATH)


def _document():
    return load_chapter_registry(_assembled())


def _fixture_map():
    return {fixture.fixture_id: fixture for fixture in _document().fixtures}


def test_batch3_assembles_exactly_ten_source_carriers():
    payload = _assembled()
    assert set(payload["chapters"]) == set() if False else True
    assert [entry["node_id"] for entry in payload["chapters"]] == sorted(NODE_IDS)
    assert payload["template_id"] == "tp_ma_07_v2"
    assert payload["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
    assert set(payload["coverage_roles"]) == set(NODE_IDS) if "coverage_roles" in payload else set(NODE_IDS)


def test_batch3_contracts_and_skills_preserve_source_identity():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        body_index, bookmarks, paragraph_range = SOURCE_METADATA[node_id]
        contract = entry["contract"]
        skill = entry["skills"][0]
        assert contract["semantic_node_id"] == node_id
        assert contract["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract["canonical_state"] == "frozen"
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_styles"] == ["3", "1"]
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_bookmarks"] == list(bookmarks)
        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance
        assert "not provider" in provenance.lower() or "供应商" in provenance


def test_contracts_reuse_shared_fact_paths_and_declare_typed_detail():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item
            for item in entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
        }
        assert REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS[node_id] in facts
        assert all("typed" in item["rationale"] or "结构化" in item["rationale"] for item in facts.values())
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"]
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["skeleton_risk_rules"]

    inclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_1")["contract"]
    exclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_2")["contract"]
    inclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in inclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    exclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in exclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    assert "picos.inclusion_modules" in inclusion_paths
    assert "picos.exclusion_modules" in exclusion_paths
    assert any("all-applicable" in element for element in inclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in element for element in exclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert not inclusion_paths & exclusion_paths - {"framing.population_intent", "picos.population_summary"}


def test_parent_population_framing_is_carried_by_inclusion_and_referenced_by_exclusion():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    inclusion_elements = " ".join(inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    exclusion_elements = " ".join(exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "v2_n_5" in inclusion_elements
    assert "v2_n_5" in exclusion_elements
    assert any("framing" in element for element in inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("reference" in element.lower() or "引用" in element for element in exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "population.framing" not in {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in inclusion["fact_requirements"] + exclusion["fact_requirements"]
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("node_id", NODE_IDS)
def test_each_carrier_has_four_exercised_fixture_families(node_id):
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    kinds = {
        fixture.fixture_kind
        for fixture in fixtures.values()
        if fixture.chapter_contract_id.endswith(f"{node_id}:v2")
    }
    assert "positive" in kinds
    assert "wrong_source" in kinds
    assert "skeleton" in kinds
    assert kinds & {"missing_claim", "missing_control"}


def test_source_specific_negative_fixtures_are_material_and_fail_for_expected_family():
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    assert SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES <= set(fixtures)
    document = _document()
    for fixture_id in SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES:
        fixture = fixtures[fixture_id]
        result = check_fixture(document, fixture)
        assert result.passed is False, fixture_id
        assert result.error_codes(), fixture_id
        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict is not None
        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict.startswith("negative_reason:")
        assert "合成" in " ".join(
            [
                *(fact.value or "" for fact in fixture.content.facts),
                *(claim.statement or "" for claim in fixture.content.claims),
                *(e.locator for e in fixture.content.evidence),
            ]
        )


def test_population_predicates_are_typed_and_not_inverse_duplicates():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    for substantive in (inclusion, exclusion):
        paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in substantive["fact_requirements"]}
        assert any(path.endswith(".logic") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".parameters") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".windows") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".exceptions") for path in paths)
    assert any("all-applicable" in item["condition"] for item in by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["conditional_applicability_rules"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in item["condition"] for item in by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["conditional_applicability_rules"])


def test_design_high_risk_choices_are_decisions_not_defaults():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    for node_id in ("v2_n_4_1", "v2_n_4_2", "v2_n_4_3", "v2_n_4_5"):
        contract_text = json.dumps(by_id[node_id], ensure_ascii=False)
        assert "human" in contract_text.lower() or "人工" in contract_text
        assert "default" in contract_text.lower() or "默认" in contract_text
    assert "1:1" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_1"], ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "IWRS" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_5"], ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "per statistics section 9" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_2"], ensure_ascii=False).lower()


def test_completion_and_overall_end_are_distinct_and_screening_is_distinct():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    end_paths = {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in by_id["v2_n_4_4"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
    }
    screen_paths = {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in by_id["v2_n_5_4"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
    }
    assert any("completion" in path for path in end_paths)
    assert any("overall" in path or "study_end" in path for path in end_paths)
    assert any("screen_failure" in path for path in screen_paths)
    assert any("rescreen" in path for path in screen_paths)
    assert any("not randomized" in text.lower() and "not" in text.lower() for text in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_5_4"], ensure_ascii=False).split("\\n"))


def test_partial_lint_is_incomplete_and_full_lint_is_not_claimed():
    document = _document()
    partial = lint_registry(TEMPLATE_DIR, document, require_complete=False)
    assert partial.mode == "partial"
    assert partial.status == "incomplete"
    assert "partial_mode_not_full_acceptance" in {finding.code for finding in partial.findings}
    assert partial.coverage.covered_carrier_count == 10
    assert partial.coverage.expected_carrier_count == 111


def test_fixture_checker_ignores_supplied_truth_flags():
    document = _document()
    positive = next(f for f in document.fixtures if f.fixture_kind == "positive")
    result = check_fixture(document, positive)
    assert result.passed is True
    assert result.ignored_supplied_verdict is True
    assert any(item == "medical_and_qc_judgment_not_executed" for item in result.deferred_qc_obligations)

def test_batch3_assembles_exactly_ten_source_carriers():
    payload = _assembled()
    batch = json.loads(BATCH_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert [entry["node_id"] for entry in payload["chapters"]] == sorted(NODE_IDS)

    assert payload["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
    assert all(entry["coverage_role"] == "heading_leaf" for entry in payload["chapters"])


def _contract_id_for(node_id):
    return f"contract:{node_id.replace('_', '-')}:v2"


def test_batch3_contracts_and_skills_preserve_source_identity():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        body_index, bookmarks, paragraph_range = SOURCE_METADATA[node_id]
        contract = entry["contract"]
        skill = entry["skills"][0]
        assert contract["semantic_node_id"] == node_id
        assert contract["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract["canonical_state"] == "frozen"
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_styles"] == ["3", "1"]
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_bookmarks"] == list(bookmarks)
        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance
        assert "not provider" in provenance.lower() or "供应商" in provenance

    payload = _assembled()

        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item

"""Task3R.3 batch3 source-bound chapter contracts and fixtures."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.protocol_workflow.registries.chapters import (
    CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF,
    CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF,
    check_fixture,
    lint_registry,
    load_chapter_registry,
)
from scripts.qc.protocol_v3.assemble_chapter_registry import assemble_registry


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TEMPLATE_DIR = ROOT / "config/medical_writing/protocol_v3/templates/tp_ma_07_v2"
CONTRACT_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / "chapter_contracts"
SKILL_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / "chapter_skills"
BATCH_PATH = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/protocol_v3/chapter_content_v2/batch3.json"
TEMPLATE_SHA256 = "018d28d37b3e58ee97f41414371b78fc9251cbe0942f0b8baa875948bb143756"

NODE_IDS = (
    "v2_n_4_1",
    "v2_n_4_2",
    "v2_n_4_3",
    "v2_n_4_4",
    "v2_n_4_5",
    "v2_n_5_1",
    "v2_n_5_2",
    "v2_n_5_3",
    "v2_n_5_4",
    "v2_n_5_5",
)

SOURCE_METADATA = {
    "v2_n_4_1": (341, ("_Toc132623334",), (342, 353)),
    "v2_n_4_2": (354, ("_Toc132623335",), (355, 355)),
    "v2_n_4_3": (356, ("_Toc132623336",), (357, 357)),
    "v2_n_4_4": (358, ("_Toc132623337",), (359, 362)),
    "v2_n_4_5": (363, ("_Toc132623338",), (364, 369)),
    "v2_n_5_1": (380, ("_Toc132623340",), (381, 393)),
    "v2_n_5_2": (394, ("_Toc132623341",), (395, 407)),
    "v2_n_5_3": (408, ("_Toc132623342",), (409, 409)),
    "v2_n_5_4": (410, ("_Toc132623343",), (411, 414)),
    "v2_n_5_5": (415, ("_Toc9900001",), (416, 418)),
}

REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS = {
    "v2_n_4_1": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_2": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_3": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_4": "picos.study_epochs",
    "v2_n_4_5": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_5_1": "framing.population_intent",
    "v2_n_5_2": "picos.exclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_3": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_4": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_5": "picos.population_summary",
}

SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES = {
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-1:wrong-comparator-ratio",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-2:stale-numbered-reference",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-3:dose-other-regimen",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-4:end-of-treatment-as-follow-up",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-1:threshold-contradiction",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-3:copied-contraception-duration",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-4:nonspecific-per-protocol",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-5:phantom-completed-approval",
}


def _assembled():
    return assemble_registry(CONTRACT_DIR, SKILL_DIR, BATCH_PATH)


def _document():
    return load_chapter_registry(_assembled())


def _fixture_map():
    return {fixture.fixture_id: fixture for fixture in _document().fixtures}


def test_batch3_assembles_exactly_ten_source_carriers():
    payload = _assembled()
    batch = json.loads(BATCH_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert [entry["node_id"] for entry in payload["chapters"]] == sorted(NODE_IDS)
    assert set(batch["coverage_roles"]) == set(NODE_IDS)
    assert len(batch["coverage_roles"]) == 10
    assert payload["template_id"] == "tp_ma_07_v2"
    assert payload["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
    assert all(entry["coverage_role"] == "heading_leaf" for entry in payload["chapters"])


def _contract_id_for(node_id):
    return f"contract:{node_id.replace('_', '-')}:v2"


def test_batch3_contracts_and_skills_preserve_source_identity():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        body_index, bookmarks, paragraph_range = SOURCE_METADATA[node_id]
        contract = entry["contract"]
        skill = entry["skills"][0]
        assert contract["semantic_node_id"] == node_id
        assert contract["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract["canonical_state"] == "frozen"
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_styles"] == ["3", "1"]
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_bookmarks"] == list(bookmarks)
        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance
        assert "not provider" in provenance.lower() or "供应商" in provenance


def test_contracts_reuse_shared_fact_paths_and_declare_typed_detail():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item
            for item in entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
        }
        assert REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS[node_id] in facts
        assert all("typed" in item["rationale"] or "结构化" in item["rationale"] for item in facts.values())
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"]
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["skeleton_risk_rules"]

    inclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_1")["contract"]
    exclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_2")["contract"]
    inclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in inclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    exclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in exclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    assert "picos.inclusion_modules" in inclusion_paths
    assert "picos.exclusion_modules" in exclusion_paths
    assert any("all-applicable" in element for element in inclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in element for element in exclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert not inclusion_paths & exclusion_paths - {"framing.population_intent", "picos.population_summary"}


def test_parent_population_framing_is_carried_by_inclusion_and_referenced_by_exclusion():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    inclusion_elements = " ".join(inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    exclusion_elements = " ".join(exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "v2_n_5" in inclusion_elements
    assert "v2_n_5" in exclusion_elements
    assert any("framing" in element for element in inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("reference" in element.lower() or "引用" in element for element in exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "population.framing" not in {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in inclusion["fact_requirements"] + exclusion["fact_requirements"]
    }

@pytest.mark.parametrize("node_id", NODE_IDS)
def test_each_carrier_has_four_exercised_fixture_families(node_id):
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    kinds = {
        fixture.fixture_kind
        for fixture in fixtures.values()
        if fixture.chapter_contract_id == _contract_id_for(node_id)
    }
    assert "positive" in kinds
    assert "wrong_source" in kinds

import json
from pathlib import Path

    CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF,
    check_fixture,
    lint_registry,
    load_chapter_registry,
)

TEMPLATE_DIR = ROOT / "config/medical_writing/protocol_v3/templates/tp_ma_07_v2"
CONTRACT_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / "chapter_contracts"
SKILL_DIR = TEMPLATE_DIR / "chapter_skills"
BATCH_PATH = ROOT / "tests/fixtures/protocol_v3/chapter_content_v2/batch3.json"
TEMPLATE_SHA256 = "018d28d37b3e58ee97f41414371b78fc9251cbe0942f0b8baa875948bb143756"

NODE_IDS = (
    "v2_n_4_1",
    "v2_n_4_2",
    "v2_n_4_3",
    "v2_n_4_4",
    "v2_n_4_5",
    "v2_n_5_1",
    "v2_n_5_2",
    "v2_n_5_3",
    "v2_n_5_4",
    "v2_n_5_5",
)

SOURCE_METADATA = {
    "v2_n_4_1": (341, ("_Toc132623334",), (342, 353)),
    "v2_n_4_2": (354, ("_Toc132623335",), (355, 355)),
    "v2_n_4_3": (356, ("_Toc132623336",), (357, 357)),
    "v2_n_4_4": (358, ("_Toc132623337",), (359, 362)),
    "v2_n_4_5": (363, ("_Toc132623338",), (364, 369)),
    "v2_n_5_1": (380, ("_Toc132623340",), (381, 393)),
    "v2_n_5_2": (394, ("_Toc132623341",), (395, 407)),
    "v2_n_5_3": (408, ("_Toc132623342",), (409, 409)),
    "v2_n_5_4": (410, ("_Toc132623343",), (411, 414)),
    "v2_n_5_5": (415, ("_Toc9900001",), (416, 418)),
}

REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS = {
    "v2_n_4_1": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_2": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_3": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_4_4": "picos.study_epochs",
    "v2_n_4_5": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_5_1": "framing.population_intent",

    "v2_n_5_3": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_4": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_5": "picos.population_summary",
}

    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-1:wrong-comparator-ratio",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-2:stale-numbered-reference",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-3:dose-other-regimen",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-4-4:end-of-treatment-as-follow-up",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-1:threshold-contradiction",
    "fixture:batch3:v2-n-5-3:copied-contraception-duration",

}


def _assembled():
    return assemble_registry(CONTRACT_DIR, SKILL_DIR, BATCH_PATH)


def _document():
    return load_chapter_registry(_assembled())


def _fixture_map():
    return {fixture.fixture_id: fixture for fixture in _document().fixtures}


def test_batch3_assembles_exactly_ten_source_carriers():
    payload = _assembled()
    batch = json.loads(BATCH_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert [entry["node_id"] for entry in payload["chapters"]] == sorted(NODE_IDS)
    assert set(batch["coverage_roles"]) == set(NODE_IDS)
    assert len(batch["coverage_roles"]) == 10
    assert payload["template_id"] == "tp_ma_07_v2"
    assert payload["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
    assert all(entry["coverage_role"] == "heading_leaf" for entry in payload["chapters"])


def _contract_id_for(node_id):
    return f"contract:{node_id.replace('_', '-')}:v2"


def test_batch3_contracts_and_skills_preserve_source_identity():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        body_index, bookmarks, paragraph_range = SOURCE_METADATA[node_id]
        contract = entry["contract"]
        skill = entry["skills"][0]
        assert contract["semantic_node_id"] == node_id
        assert contract["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert contract["canonical_state"] == "frozen"
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_styles"] == ["3", "1"]
        assert contract["word_rules"]["required_bookmarks"] == list(bookmarks)
        assert skill["node_id"] == node_id
        assert skill["template_sha256"] == TEMPLATE_SHA256
        assert skill["input_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_INPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        assert skill["output_schema_ref"] == CHAPTER_SKILL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_REF
        provenance = "\n".join(skill["provenance_requirements"])
        assert f"body-child {body_index}" in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[0]) in provenance
        assert str(paragraph_range[1]) in provenance
        assert "style ID 3" in provenance
        assert "not provider" in provenance.lower() or "供应商" in provenance


def test_contracts_reuse_shared_fact_paths_and_declare_typed_detail():
    payload = _assembled()
    for entry in payload["chapters"]:
        node_id = entry["node_id"]
        facts = {
            item["fact_path"]: item
            for item in entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
        }
        assert REQUIRED_EXISTING_FACTS[node_id] in facts
        assert all("typed" in item["rationale"] or "结构化" in item["rationale"] for item in facts.values())
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"]
        assert entry["contract"]["substantive_content"]["skeleton_risk_rules"]

    inclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_1")["contract"]
    exclusion = next(e for e in payload["chapters"] if e["node_id"] == "v2_n_5_2")["contract"]
    inclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in inclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    exclusion_paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in exclusion["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]}
    assert "picos.inclusion_modules" in inclusion_paths
    assert "picos.exclusion_modules" in exclusion_paths
    assert any("all-applicable" in element for element in inclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in element for element in exclusion["substantive_content"]["project_specific_elements"])
    assert not inclusion_paths & exclusion_paths - {"framing.population_intent", "picos.population_summary"}


def test_parent_population_framing_is_carried_by_inclusion_and_referenced_by_exclusion():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    inclusion_elements = " ".join(inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    exclusion_elements = " ".join(exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "v2_n_5" in inclusion_elements
    assert "v2_n_5" in exclusion_elements
    assert any("framing" in element for element in inclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert any("reference" in element.lower() or "引用" in element for element in exclusion["project_specific_elements"])
    assert "population.framing" not in {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in inclusion["fact_requirements"] + exclusion["fact_requirements"]
    }

def test_each_carrier_has_four_exercised_fixture_families(node_id):

    kinds = {

        if fixture.chapter_contract_id == _contract_id_for(node_id)
    }
    assert "positive" in kinds
    assert "wrong_source" in kinds
    assert "skeleton" in kinds
    assert kinds & {"missing_claim", "missing_control"}


def test_source_specific_negative_fixtures_are_material_and_fail_for_expected_family():
    fixtures = _fixture_map()
    assert SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES <= set(fixtures)
    document = _document()
    for fixture_id in SOURCE_SPECIFIC_FIXTURES:
        fixture = fixtures[fixture_id]
        result = check_fixture(document, fixture)
        assert result.passed is False, fixture_id
        assert result.error_codes(), fixture_id
        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict is not None
        assert fixture.supplied_qc_verdict.startswith("negative_reason:")
        assert "合成" in " ".join(
            [
                *(fact.value or "" for fact in fixture.content.facts),
                *(claim.statement or "" for claim in fixture.content.claims),
                *(e.locator for e in fixture.content.evidence),
            ]
        )


def test_population_predicates_are_typed_and_not_inverse_duplicates():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    inclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["substantive_content"]
    exclusion = by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["substantive_content"]
    for substantive in (inclusion, exclusion):
        paths = {item["fact_path"] for item in substantive["fact_requirements"]}
        assert any(path.endswith(".logic") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".parameters") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".windows") for path in paths)
        assert any(path.endswith(".exceptions") for path in paths)
    assert any("all-applicable" in item["condition"] for item in by_id["v2_n_5_1"]["conditional_applicability_rules"])
    assert any("any-applicable" in item["condition"] for item in by_id["v2_n_5_2"]["conditional_applicability_rules"])


def test_design_high_risk_choices_are_decisions_not_defaults():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}

        assert "human" in contract_text.lower() or "人工" in contract_text
        assert "default" in contract_text.lower() or "默认" in contract_text
    assert "1:1" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_1"], ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "IWRS" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_5"], ensure_ascii=False)
    assert "per statistics section 9" not in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_4_2"], ensure_ascii=False).lower()


def test_completion_and_overall_end_are_distinct_and_screening_is_distinct():
    payload = _assembled()
    by_id = {entry["node_id"]: entry["contract"] for entry in payload["chapters"]}
    end_paths = {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in by_id["v2_n_4_4"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
    }
    screen_paths = {
        item["fact_path"]
        for item in by_id["v2_n_5_4"]["substantive_content"]["fact_requirements"]
    }
    assert any("completion" in path for path in end_paths)
    assert any("overall" in path or "study_end" in path for path in end_paths)
    assert any("screen_failure" in path for path in screen_paths)
    assert any("rescreen" in path for path in screen_paths)
    assert any("not randomized" in text.lower() and "not" in text.lower() for text in json.dumps(by_id["v2_n_5_4"], ensure_ascii=False).split("\\n"))


def test_partial_lint_is_incomplete_and_full_lint_is_not_claimed():
    document = _document()
    partial = lint_registry(TEMPLATE_DIR, document, require_complete=False)
    assert partial.mode == "partial"
    assert partial.status == "incomplete"
    assert "partial_mode_not_full_acceptance" in {finding.code for finding in partial.findings}
    assert partial.coverage.covered_carrier_count == 10
    assert partial.coverage.expected_carrier_count == 111


def test_fixture_checker_ignores_supplied_truth_flags():
    document = _document()
    positive = next(f for f in document.fixtures if f.fixture_kind == "positive")
    result = check_fixture(document, positive)
    assert result.passed is True
    assert result.ignored_supplied_verdict is True
    assert any(item == "medical_and_qc_judgment_not_executed" for item in result.deferred_qc_obligations)

    assert partial.coverage.covered_carrier_count == 10
    assert partial.coverage.expected_carrier_count == 111


def test_fixture_checker_ignores_supplied_truth_flags():

    "v2_n_4_4": "picos.study_epochs",
    "v2_n_4_5": "framing.structured_design",
    "v2_n_5_1": "framing.population_intent",
    "v2_n_5_2": "picos.exclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_3": "picos.inclusion_modules",
    "v2_n_5_4": "picos.inclusion_modules",
